items.title: 56422_Leonard Phillips oral history interview
items.q: Yeah, she came here with me. We came together.

ctx.x: So she came to D.C. with you.

Yeah, she came here with me. We came together. In fact, she came here before I did. I sent her here first because I knew I was coming. I sent her here first and she got everything straightened out. Then we said, "Come on, man. We got a place we gonna take you." Booker said, "Yeah." Because, see, Booker was up there playing, too, in...
